decisions.reason: With only a brief mention and no visible traction in a narrow niche after four years, the option's value likely no longer justifies keeping it open.
The launch of a new LED replacement kit signals ongoing commitment and resolved positive uncertainty, so the option is worth exercising.
As a relaunch of a popular designer line, it has demonstrated market acceptance, reducing uncertainty and justifying continued support.
A standard office pendant faces low uncertainty and likely commoditized margins after three years, so continued option value is limited.
A premium pendant retains design-led option value with potentially high margins, so keeping it open is inexpensive relative to its upside.
